mapping_policy: Mappings are candidate relevance links, not proof that the source fully teaches the module or that the module is complete. Direct means topic fit appears close; supplementary means supporting context only; safety_guardrail means safety boundary/escalation reference, not instruction to perform hazardous work.
baseline_id_policy: Baseline module IDs use BASE-* and are not accepted by RESOURCE_RECORD.schema.json linked_object_ids. To preserve schema conformance, resource records link to ATH-DISC-* only; this separate crosswalk carries BASE-* candidate links. Do not change the schema or mint canonical module IDs silently.
